tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background. Light pages are white by brand rule; never cream or grey.

tokens.name: bg-alt
tokens.usage: Alternate page sections (features, pricing) and the profile page ground. A blue-white, not grey.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, menus, dashboard content area.

tokens.name: surface-tint
tokens.usage: Chips, tags, step numbers, photo placeholders, selected rows. Pale blue instead of grey boxes.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline borders on cards and dividers (decorative, not for inputs).

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Input, checkbox and secondary-button outlines. Meets 3:1 against bg and surface.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings on bg, bg-alt, surface and surface-tint. Deep ink, never pure black.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Body copy on public pages, captions, secondary labels. 6.2:1 or better on every light ground.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, links, the y in the wordmark, the mark, focus rings, selected state.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of primary buttons and links.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a primary fill. 7:1 light, 8.2:1 dark.

tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: Brand dark accent: dashboard sidebar highlights, emphasis cards. Pair with white or sky text.

tokens.name: ink-band
tokens.usage: Background fill for full-width dark bands (closing call to action, dashboard sidebar), not a text colour. Text on it uses on-band (16:1 light, 9.4:1 dark); accents use sky. In dark mode it is navy so the band stays distinct from surface cards.

tokens.name: on-band
tokens.usage: Text on ink-band.

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Accent on dark grounds only: the y and mark on ink-band, buttons on the dark band. Never as text on white.

tokens.name: sand
tokens.usage: The one warm touch, in small doses: illustration fills, a highlight behind a photo. Never text, never large fields.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Confirmed, paid, published. Text or icon on bg/surface.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Pending payment, booking limit near. Text on warning-soft or surface.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Background of warning notices, including the emergency-services note on report pages.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors, destructive actions, risk flags on assessments.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Home page hero only. Set font-variation-settings 'SOFT' 100, 'WONK' 0.

styles.name: heading-md
styles.usage: Therapist name on a profile; card titles on public pages.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Online booking, payments in naira, video sessions and client records.
styles.usage: Intro paragraph under a public heading. ink-muted.

styles.name: body-public
styles.sample: Most people who come to me are doing well on the outside and struggling on the inside.
styles.usage: Running text on therapysts.com and profile pages, read on phones.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Dashboard text, table cells, card body.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase kicker above public headings, in primary.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: No card needed · Your address: therapysts.com/yourname
styles.usage: Small print under buttons, metadata. ink-muted.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to text.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Chip gaps, tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button groups, label to field.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card grids; minimum side gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding; page gutter on desktop.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between blocks inside a section.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between hero columns.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of public page sections.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, small tiles, dashboard rows.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Step numbers, icon tiles.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and panels.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Profile cards and large previews.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: All buttons, chips and tags. Buttons are always pills.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Floating previews only (profile card, dashboard mock). Ordinary cards use a border, not a shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, the small card overlapping the hero mock.
